title: Pandan rice porridge with salted duck egg and dried fish #vietnamesefood #asiafood #shorts
description: Pandan rice porridge with salted duck egg and dried fish is a simple and comforting Vietnamese dish. The porridge is gently cooked with pandan leaves for a light, fragrant aroma and is usually served with salted duck egg and savory dried fish. It is a popular everyday meal in Vietnam, especially for breakfast or a light dinner.
